title: silicone trivets
text: silicone trivets. I purchased these to put over bowls in the microwave instead of a paper towel or paper plate.  They are dishwasher safe, but I haven't found an effective way to wash them in the dishwasher.  They are honeycombed on both sides so when you wash them it's difficult to shake out all the water, but at least I'm not throwing away paper plates /towels. They definitely would work as trivets.  They are thick.  You get multi colors and 5 of them.
